title: A Family Trip
text:
Many people travel every day. They go to work, to school, or on vacation. Some people travel by car, and some people travel by bus. My family likes to travel by train because it is fast.

Last summer, my family took a trip to the beach. We went by plane. The airport was big and busy. At the beach, we swam in the sea and ate ice cream.

questions.text: How does the writer's family like to travel?
How did the family go to the beach?
What can we infer about the family's summer trip?
options: They did not like the sea

questions.text: What kind of person is the writer most likely to be?
options: A person who never leaves home
A person who works at an airport
A person who does not like the beach

vocabulary.definition: to go from one place to another
a place where planes take off and land
a sandy place next to the sea

paragraph_translations: Багато людей подорожують щодня. Вони їдуть на роботу, до школи або у відпустку. Деякі люди їдуть на машині, а деякі — на автобусі. Моя родина любить подорожувати потягом, бо він швидкий.
Минулого літа моя родина поїхала на море. Ми полетіли літаком. Аеропорт був великим і жвавим. На пляжі ми плавали в морі та їли морозиво.
